title: Luminance contrast versus chromatic contrast for reading speed and legibility
statement:
Reading speed and legibility depend almost entirely on luminance contrast rather than chromatic contrast (hue differences) between text and background.

Options:
- Optimal Reading: High Luminance Contrast (fits: articles, documentation)
- Poor Legibility (Avoid): Pure Chromatic Contrast (fits: art projects only)
- Reduced Eye Strain: Moderate Luminance Contrast (fits: dashboards, long form reading)
appliesWhen: Applies to: typography, content heavy sites. Audience: general, seniors.

source.title: Psychophysics of reading. XI. Comparing color contrast and luminance contrast
source.authors: Gordon E. Legge; Denis G. Pelli; S. S. Rubin; R. A. Schleske
source.venue: Journal of the Optical Society of America A
